stemMd: A sediment-free stirred tank below the warming threshold becomes cloudy only when spring water is added. Which statement best describes how this controlled result bears on the natural lake?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It proves that every cloudy lake on Earth has the same cause.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It proves wind never lifts any mineral particle anywhere.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It supports a mechanism under controlled tank conditions; confirming its role in the lake requires relevant field evidence

options.label: D
options.textMd: It is irrelevant because controlled experiments can never inform natural processes.

explanationMd: A controlled result establishes that the proposed mechanism can produce the outcome under the tested conditions. Evidence about actual spring flow, mixing and cloudiness in the lake is still needed to establish its field role.

distractorRationale.a: One controlled system cannot establish a universal lake mechanism.
distractorRationale.d: Controlled tests can distinguish proposed mechanisms.
distractorRationale.b: The result concerns this test and does not rule out sediment suspension in other settings.
